Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. EMD Submission is mandatory for everyone and hard copy of the EMD must be delivered at department before Bid end date. Exemption for EMD as per government Norms only for 2. Bidder shall be registered OEM authorized reseller, bid specific MAF required along with the authorized contact number and mail address for all items. Bid No. should be mentioned on Document. 3. Delivery period for all the products is strictly 45 days, if bidder fails to deliver the 4. material in 45 days, 0.5 % L.D/Week (late delivery) charges with be imposed on seller. 5. The Bidder should not have been blacklisted by any PSU/Govt. Dept. in doing business with them anywhere in India at any time (Affidavit to be submitted on 100 Rs Non-Judicial

Stamp). 6. The Bidder (as a Reseller) must have an annual turnover of Rs. 10 lakh or more in any one of the last three financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, or FY 2025-26. As proof thereof , copies of the Audited Annual Accounts / Statutory CA Certificate for the last three financial years shall be uploaded along with the bid. 7. The Bidder must submit their valid PAN, GST Registration Certificate. 8. Provide Valid MSME Registration of OEM. 9. If the bidder is participating in the bid as an OEM, the bidder must have a minimum turnover of R s. 1 Crore in at least one financial year during the last three financial years. If the bidder is participating in the bid as a Reseller, the bidder’s OEM must have a minimum turnover of Rs. 1 0 Crore in at least one financial year during the last three financial years. · For a Reseller, submission of the OEM’s Turnover Certificate shall be mandatory and The Reseller shall also be required to submit its own turnover details in accordanc e with the above-mentioned turnover requirements. · For an OEM, submission of the bidder’s own Turnover Certificate in the capacity of O EM shall be mandatory. 10. . Bidder or its OEM must have ISO 9001-2015, ISO 14001-2015, ISO 45001-2018, and same must b e uploaded with technical evaluation documents. Bidder or its OEM Have Valid BIFAM Registration Certification. 11. It is mandatory for every bidder to Visit the site before bid end date for products and site related informati on and proof of the same required to upload with technical evaluation documents. 12. It is mandatory to submit detailed catalogue of offered products Dimension planning layout of item along with technical bid otherwise the bid will be rejected. 13. Bidder have services centre in Bhopal and preferred M.P. based OEM. 14. Provide 12-month warranty on product against any manufacturing defect from date of supply. 15. Provide Last Three Years IT returns of last three years of Bidder. 16. Provide Factory License or Incorporation certificate (Certificate Issued By Registrar of Companies) of OEM or Bidder. 17. Any kind of deviation from product specification and terms and condition not allowed. The following information on the letter head of the company / bidder: • Compliance for commercial terms of tender • Compliance for technical specifications of the equipment to be supplied .
